name: Sendspin Image
description: Instructions for displaying Sendspin album and artist artwork in ESPHome.

config_entries.label: Type
config_entries.description: Specifies how to encode the image internally.

config_entries.label: Current Image
config_entries.description: The image showing the artwork that is currently playing. or LVGL code.

config_entries.label: Format
config_entries.description: The format the artwork is encoded with. One of JPEG, PNG or BMP.

config_entries.label: Placeholder
config_entries.description: ID of another image to display until the first artwork has been received. This placeholder image will not be resized. It only applies when the image is drawn from a display lambda; LVGL widgets show nothing instead.

config_entries.label: Resize
config_entries.description: The size the artwork is requested and rendered at, as WIDTHxHEIGHT. The Sendspin server scales the artwork to these dimensions before sending it.

config_entries.label: Sendspin ID
config_entries.description: The ID of the Sendspin hub to attach to. Only needed if you have more than one hub configured.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: The ID of the artwork slot. Use this to target the action below.

config_entries.label: Byte Order
config_entries.description: For RGB565 images, the pixels are converted to 16 bit values. By default these are stored in little endian byte order (LSB first), but you can override this by setting byte_order to big_endian. Options are little_endian (default) and big_endian. Not applicable to other image formats.

config_entries.label: Display Offset
config_entries.description: Request a shift when on_image_display fires relative to the moment the server asked for the artwork to appear. A positive value fires it early, a negative value delays it. Must be a whole number of milliseconds between -60s and 60s. Defaults to 0ms.

config_entries.label: Source
config_entries.description: Which artwork to display. One of album (default) or artist.

config_entries.label: Transition Image
config_entries.description: A second image holding the outgoing artwork while a transition runs, for transitions that must keep it on screen after on_image_display returns. It holds the current artwork at any other time, and is black until the first artwork has been shown. When set, the server is not told the device is ready for more artwork until sendspin.image.transition_finished runs. See Cross-fading between tracks.

config_entries.label: Transparency
config_entries.description: If set, the alpha channel of the artwork will be taken into account. The possible values are opaque (default), chroma_key and alpha_channel. See the discussion on transparency in the image component.
